Can my business start using NEVORA now?
Yes. Ask for a free 30-day trial. We reply within two business days and set up your workplace with you. NEVORA is available now in any browser, and the phone app is coming to the App Store and Google Play.
Does NEVORA pay my employees or file payroll taxes?
No. NEVORA calculates pay from the hours you approve and makes a pay statement for each person. You still pay your team and file payroll taxes.
How much does NEVORA cost?
After the free 30 days, $19 a month for up to 15 employees or $29 a month for 16 to 30, per business. Prices may change before online billing opens. More than 30 employees?

What happens on day 30?
On day 30, the Owner picks a plan in NEVORA. Nothing is charged until you do. Without a plan, NEVORA pauses for your team.
What can Rondo do?
Rondo answers the Owner’s questions about today’s team, coverage and recorded hours from your workplace’s records, and can prepare a coverage change for the Owner to approve. It is for the Owner only.

¿Cómo consigue mi negocio NEVORA?
Pide una prueba gratis de 30 días en la página de Planes. El registro en línea todavía no está abierto, así que configuramos tu lugar de trabajo contigo. Después de la prueba, el negocio paga $19 al mes para hasta 15 empleados o $29 al mes para 16 a 30, con la app completa. ¿Me pueden dar un precio o una fecha de entrega aquí?
No en el sitio web. Le ponemos precio a un proyecto cuando acordamos su alcance, y dejamos los honorarios, los hitos y las fechas de entrega en el acuerdo de proyecto por escrito.
¿Una consulta inicia un contrato?
No. Una consulta inicia una conversación. No compra un producto ni da inicio a trabajo pagado.
¿Dónde envío información confidencial?
No envíes contraseñas, claves de API, datos de pago ni registros confidenciales por un formulario público o por correo normal. Primero pide un canal adecuado.
¿Cómo funciona la prueba gratis de NEVORA?
Un negocio con hasta 30 empleados puede usar NEVORA gratis por 30 días desde el día en que su lugar de trabajo queda configurado. No se necesita tarjeta y no se cobra nada. El día 30 te suscribes o NEVORA queda en pausa para tu equipo. Terminar la prueba no inicia ninguna eliminación automática. Para cerrar un lugar de trabajo o preguntar por sus registros, escribe a
support@thevelani.com
. Un equipo de más de 30 nos escribe primero: revisamos si califica y te damos una cotización, y los equipos aprobados reciben los mismos 30 días gratis. NEVORA calcula los comprobantes de nómina; no les paga a los empleados ni presenta impuestos de nómina.

Website platform information

Shopify, the website platform, also collects visit and page-view information for analytics. Before a conversation starts, Cloudflare Turnstile checks that the request comes from a browser and not from an automated program. Answers can be wrong, and product details may change. Privacy choices and requests
Open Cookie choices to review the choices this website offers. Write to
support@thevelani.com
to ask what we hold about you, to correct it or to have it deleted. The law that applies to you sets which rights you have. Before we act on a request, we may ask you to confirm your identity in a way that fits the request.
Product and client data
This notice concerns the company website. NEVORA workplace records are covered by the NEVORA privacy policy. Client processing, including any controller/processor responsibilities, must be covered by the relevant engagement and data-processing terms.
Changes to this notice
When we change this notice, we update the date at the top of the page. This notice does not certify compliance with any standard.

Who we are
NEVORA is a workforce scheduling and operations service provided by VELANI LLC. This policy explains how information is handled when you use NEVORA through its website or mobile applications. Contact us at
support@thevelani.com
or by mail at VELANI LLC, 1654 Calle Tulipan, Suite 100, San Juan, PR 00927.
02
Your workplace
Your employer or organization supplies and manages the information used to run its workspace. Authorized people in your workplace can see information according to their roles.
Your employer decides how NEVORA is used for workplace activities, including scheduling, attendance, timekeeping, payroll records and employee administration. VELANI LLC operates NEVORA and processes these workplace records on your employer’s documented instructions. Requests about workplace records your employer controls are coordinated with your employer, and VELANI LLC helps locate, correct, export or delete information where appropriate. VELANI LLC handles requests about information it controls for its own business purposes, such as direct support communications and service administration. Your employer remains responsible for employment decisions, payroll accuracy, required workplace notices and its own recordkeeping obligations.
Contact your workplace administrator about schedules, pay records or corrections. You can also contact us about privacy, or use the account deletion process below.
03
Information NEVORA uses
Depending on the features your organization turns on and your role, NEVORA handles:
Account and work profile information, such as your name, sign-in and contact details, employee ID, role, workplace and assigned work locations.
Scheduling and attendance information, such as shifts, availability, time-off requests, shift exchanges, recorded work and break times, corrections and approval history.
Payroll-related information and documents where those features are turned on, including the pay records your organization enters.
Workplace content, such as company updates, shift notes, requests and acknowledgements.
Service and security information, such as sign-in and session records, access events, support requests and the technical information needed to deliver and protect the service.
Notification delivery information, such as push subscriptions on devices where you turn notifications on.
Information comes from you, your organization and its authorized users, your use of NEVORA, and the service providers that perform these functions. If a feature needs a device permission, it explains why when it asks.
04
Why we use information
To give you access to your account, show authorized work information, run scheduling and attendance features, process permitted requests, deliver workplace communications, provide payroll-related features your organization turns on, answer support requests, investigate misuse, protect accounts and meet applicable obligations.
05
Who receives information
Your organization and its authorized users receive the information their roles need. Service providers process information for us: Vercel hosts the application and runs its servers; Neon stores the database; a transactional email provider delivers recovery codes and other account email; and your browser’s push service, run by its maker (such as Apple, Google or Mozilla), delivers the notifications you turn on. We may disclose information when the law requires it, or when it’s necessary to address fraud, security incidents or threats to anyone’s rights or safety, as the law allows.
06
Advertising and tracking
NEVORA does not display advertisements, sell personal information, or share personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising. We do not track users across other companies’ applications or websites for advertising purposes. We disclose information to your employer and our service providers as necessary to operate NEVORA and for the purposes described in this policy.
07
Where information is processed
Our database and application servers are in the United States, in Northern Virginia. Email delivery, push notification services and our providers’ logs and support may process information in other locations.
08
How long we keep information
Free trial workplaces:
when an unpaid trial ends, operational access is restricted. The Owner can open billing and export available payroll records; employees can still view their own available pay statements. Trial expiry does not start an automatic workplace-deletion timer. This does not promise indefinite retention: this policy and a verified deletion request still govern which records are kept or removed. The periods below apply to workplaces on a plan.
We keep information only as long as we need it. Each period follows the age of the record; a deletion request doesn’t restart it. Where a record fits more than one category, the longest period applies.
Attendance, approved timecards, payroll calculations, published pay statements
and their corrections and approvals: three years from the record’s final entry, or longer when the employment-tax rule below or another requirement applies. They preserve wage calculations, payment history and evidence for payroll questions or disputes.
Records supporting employment taxes:
at least four years after the tax is due or paid, whichever is later.
Security and access logs NEVORA manages:
up to 90 days from the logged event, to investigate unauthorized access and keep the service secure.
Records of privacy requests:
24 months after the request is closed, to show what was asked, how it was handled and any record kept.
Optional profile information and account data
with no continuing lawful purpose: removed within the deletion timetable below.
Records under a legal hold or unresolved dispute:
until the hold is released and the period that otherwise applies has passed.
When a record has to be kept, we limit its use and access to that purpose. Backups: Our database keeps a restore history of seven days, so changed or deleted information drops out of it after seven days. We may also keep separate recovery snapshots taken for a specific purpose, such as before a database upgrade. They are restricted to that purpose, are never used to restore your account after deletion, and are deleted once they are no longer needed for it.
09
Your choices and requests
You can manage notifications in NEVORA and in your device settings. Use your profile, or ask your workplace administrator, to correct workplace information. Email
support@thevelani.com
about access, correction, deletion or other privacy requests. We confirm your identity in a way that fits the request. NEVORA serves employers and their authorized workforces in the United States and Puerto Rico. Applicable United States federal and Puerto Rico requirements govern the handling of relevant workplace records.
10
Deleting your account
Open Profile, choose Delete my account, re-enter your password and confirm. If you no longer have the app, sign in to NEVORA on the web and do the same; see
Account deletion
. Before you confirm, we show what is removed and what may be kept for a specific obligation. We aim to complete eligible deletion requests within 30 calendar days after we receive the request. We confirm it’s you before deleting anything; if some information must be kept, or the law allows more time, we explain why and for how long. Deleting your NEVORA account doesn’t change your employment.
11
Security
We protect information with measures that fit it, including role-based access and encrypted connections. No way of storing or sending information removes every risk. Email
support@thevelani.com
if you think someone else has used your account. Never send passwords, verification codes or payroll documents by email.
12
Changes
NEVORA is meant for authorized workplace use. We post changes to this policy with a new effective date and give additional notice where required. Questions go to
support@thevelani.com
.
